data_scope: Author-released frozen device traces and public-input RC simulation outputs. No phone/watch recordings or proprietary Origin software.
processing: Source CSV bytes copied without alteration. Only explicit row normalization for confusion matrices; other numerical arrays unchanged. No fitting, smoothing, classifier training, new inference or sample selection.
public_input_dataset: UTD-MHAD inertial records, actions 1-10, 8 subjects, 319 usable trials

figure_notes.caption: LIGHT: existing public UTD-MHAD 10-action device-model RC simulation, Softmax readout, 2-bit shared 0-3 nA quantization, 8 held-out subjects. 319 out-of-fold predictions. Row-normalized counts; class 8 has 31 records, all other classes have 32. Not a hardware or phone/watch RC experiment.

DARK: existing public UTD-MHAD 10-action device-model RC simulation, Softmax readout, 2-bit shared 0-3 nA quantization, 8 held-out subjects. 319 out-of-fold predictions. Row-normalized counts; class 8 has 31 records, all other classes have 32. Not a hardware or phone/watch RC experiment.
Existing non-stretched light-state device measurement and frozen-model replay. Ten events, 175 readings; prior calibration protocol, not new independent measurements.

Existing frozen light and dark device-model simulations driven by the same 40 unit events, interval 0.13906 s, zero initial state, 1039 points per condition. Unquantized model currents; not new paired physical measurements.

Existing measured recovery after 100 events and frozen-model prediction. 1577 points each. Diagnostic protocol excluded from model fitting. All supplied positive plotting points and model values retained; extended logarithmic limits show the complete model tail. The frozen model underestimates the slow recovery.

Existing unquantized light-state reservoir-current simulation. 40 read steps by 150 input branches, all 6000 states shown. Rows are read steps in chronological top-to-bottom order; columns are branches. Fixed 0-3 nA scale. This map is not a confusion matrix or a hardware array image.

Historical 100-pulse recovery diagnostic from the earlier L3/C3 modeling comparison. Existing measured, Linear 3-state and Coupled-saturation traces, 1563 points each. At the nearest reading to 10 s (10.008392334 s), L3 relative current error is -33.1568553%, displayed as -33.2%. These are historical candidates, not the final RC model or a classification metric.
